messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: Production us-west-2 - tail latency increase (~95th-99th) observed after rollout of payload-slicing scheduler v2.4. Pager: @maya oncall. CI link: https://redwood.in/ci/7990012345 :rotating_light:

maya: saw the page, I'm on it. grabbing recent deploy info.

devon: I can help with traces and kernel selector logs. noticing higher KV eviction rate across the canary slice.

jonah: telemetry shows microbatch window dropped from 8ms -> 3ms on new scheduler, causing more frequent small batches and more KV churn.

ops-eli: are customers impacted? any 5xx?

support-alex: some customers reporting slow responses in the last 4m, no mass 5xx, elevated p95/p99. CS queue has 2 tickets mentioning timeouts on long prompts.

maya: good context. devon, can you paste the kernel fallback traces?

devon: pasting tail of selector log: ```WARN kernel_selector.cpp: fallback to generic-kernel for model-embedder on host rwd-uw2-12 - latency delta +120ms; kv_cache_evictions=87/min```

jonah: that's the one. scheduler v2.4 changed batch alignment which increased async eviction pressure, which causes frequent kernel fallback decisions.

maya: immediate mitigation options: 1) flip scheduler v2.4 feature flag off in prod 2) rollback canary to v2.3 3) apply temporary prefactor to batch-window to 8ms via runtime override. preferences?

ops-eli: prefer feature-flag flip first — faster and less blast radius than rollback. we should also prepare rollback if flag flip doesn't help.

deploy-bot: feature-flag toggle API: POST https://flags.redwood.in/toggle - payload {"flag":"scheduler_v2","env":"prod","value":false} (requires SSO).

maya: I'm going to request flag flip. tagging @devon to validate after.

maya: @deploy-bot please run toggle.

deploy-bot: ACK. Kicking off flag flip for scheduler_v2 in prod. Estimated propagation 30s.

sre-bot: Flag flip started by maya. Watch group: eng-runtime, eng-oncall.

devon: watching telemetry... p95 starting to trend down after 45s. KV eviction rate dropping back to baseline at 90s.

jonah: kernels stabilizing, fallback events decreasing. still seeing a small delta on hosts rwd-uw2-04 and rwd-uw2-08.

maya: do we want to keep the flag off and clean up the canary?

product-lina: product note: no major feature change here beyond scheduler perf. If flip resolves, we can hold and do a controlled re-roll with adjusted batch-window tuning. Notify affected customers via status page.

support-alex: preparing status note draft. will wait 10m for stabilization before posting.

ops-eli: if any host keeps thrashing, we may need to cordon and reprovision. let's keep that as T2.

maya: agreed. for now: flag off, monitor 30m, prepare rollback playbook if any regression or new errors appear.

devon: logging action items: 1) collect kernel_selector logs for last 15m from impacted hosts 2) annotate canary deploy diff (scheduler params) 3) run load replay on staging with v2.4 + tuned batch-window to validate.

jonah: I'll run the staging replay and post results in #eng-runtime.

sre-bot: Incident open: id INC-7990. Pager assigned: maya. Severity: sev2 (customer latency, no mass errors).

maya: closing loop here — flag flip succeeded and p99/p95 improved ~60% over the spike. keeping incident open for monitoring and next steps. I'll hand off to eng-runtime for repro and rollout plan. anyone else? :thumbsup:
